map.计算转化率、转化成本，评估营销效果: Compute conversion rate and cost per conversion to evaluate marketing performance
map.📖 查看「转化率计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Conversion Rate Calculator User Guide"
map.进入页面或点击广告的人数: People who land on the page or click the ad
map.完成目标动作的人数: People who complete the target action
map.可选，用于计算转化成本: Optional, used to compute cost per conversion
map.转化率（Conversion Rate）是指完成目标动作的用户占总访问用户的比例: Conversion rate is the share of visitors who complete a target action. The target action can be registration, purchase, download, form submission and so on.
map.转化成本(CPA) = 总花费 ÷ 转化数: Cost per conversion (CPA) = total spend / conversions
map.ROI = (转化收入 - 总花费) ÷ 总花费 × 100%: ROI = (conversion revenue - total spend) / total spend × 100%
map.例如：10,000人访问，300人转化，转化率 = 300 ÷ 10,000 ×: For example with 10,000 visits and 300 conversions, conversion rate = 300 / 10,000 × 100% = 3%
map.：广告被多少人看到: : how many people saw the ad
map.：清晰的价值主张、简洁的设计: : a clear value proposition and clean design
map.：客户评价、权威认证、安全标识: : customer reviews, authoritative certifications and security badges
map.：持续测试优化关键元素: : keep testing and optimizing key elements
map.各行业平均转化率参考: Reference average conversion rates by industry
map.：获得一个转化的成本: : the cost of winning one conversion
map.：获得一个销售订单的成本: : the cost of winning one sales order
map.：访问到转化的比例: : the ratio from visit to conversion
map.：客户终身价值（判断CPA是否合理）: : customer lifetime value (to judge whether CPA is reasonable)
map.📚 深度解析：转化率与转化成本: 📚 In-depth: Conversion Rate and Cost per Conversion
map.活动后算每单转化成本 CPA 与整体: After a campaign, compute CPA per order and overall
map.对比不同渠道 CPA 决定预算倾斜。: Compare CPA across channels to decide where budget should shift.
map.给定客单价反推转化带来的利润。: Given an average order value, work back the profit from conversions.
map.总花费 5000、转化 100、客单价 200 → CPA=50 元；收入=10: Total spend 5000 with 100 conversions and an average order value of 200 gives CPA = 50 CNY; revenue = 100×200 = 20000, profit = 20000 − 5000 = 15000 and ROI = 15000/5000 = 300%.
map.渠道 A CPA=40、渠道 B CPA=80，同样客单价下 A 利润更高，预算: Channel A CPA = 40 and channel B CPA = 80: at the same average order value A earns more profit, so give budget to A first until marginal CPA levels out.
map.CPA 和 CPC 区别？: How do CPA and CPC differ?
map.CPC 是单次点击价，CPA 是单次转化（成交/留资）价，CPA 更贴近业务结果: CPC is the price per click and CPA the price per conversion (purchase or lead), so CPA is closer to the business outcome.
map.负 ROI 说明获客不划算，先降 CPA（优化落地页/定向）或提客单价，而非加预: Negative ROI means acquisition does not pay; cut CPA first (landing page and targeting) or raise average order value, rather than adding budget.
